question_text: Find if the two cubes are alike. Write 'Yes' or 'No'.

reference_figures.label: Cube 1
reference_figures.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><path d='M30 30 L70 30 L85 15 L45 15 Z M30 30 L30 70 L70 70 L70 30 M70 70 L85 55 L85 15' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='2'/><text x='45' y='55' font-size='20'>P</text><text x='52' y='26' font-size='15'>Q</text><text x='74' y='45' font-size='15'>R</text></svg>

reference_figures.label: Cube 2
reference_figures.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><path d='M30 30 L70 30 L85 15 L45 15 Z M30 30 L30 70 L70 70 L70 30 M70 70 L85 55 L85 15' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='2'/><text x='45' y='55' font-size='20'>Q</text><text x='52' y='26' font-size='15'>P</text><text x='74' y='45' font-size='15'>R</text></svg>

explanation: In Cube 1, reading clockwise around the shared vertex: P -> Q -> R. In Cube 2, the clockwise sequence around that same corner is Q -> P -> R. The order of P and Q is reversed, making them mirror images, not identical rotations.
